text:
Jordan (CS): Morning team  weekly SummitAI latency heatmap and mode contrast. Notable: streaming consistently reduces p95 and tightens p99 on /chat; /rerank non-stream tail still problematic. Table below (7d rolling, ms/pct/error%/reqs).

Priya (SRE): drop the numbers pls. I'm particularly curious about p99 windows and whether retries amplified any tail.

Jordan (CS): heres the compact table.

```
route    model     mode         p95  p99   err%  req/day
/chat    t6-small  streaming    230  740   0.22  19k
/chat    t6-small  non-stream   440 1280  0.95  2.9k
/comp    gpt-lite  sync         690 1950  2.1   4.4k
/embed   pico      streaming     49  135  0.03  61k
/rerank  llama2    non-stream   1050 2750  3.6   860
```

Luca (SE): rerank looks like batching + retries. Any evidence of heavy tail from specific batch sizes?

Priya (SRE): yes. Correlated with daytime batch jobs that batch >3k tokens. We saw 2 OOMs at 02:47 and retry cascades at 02:48 UTC. Increasing dedicated pool memory reduced rate last night.

Zoe (Customer): we noticed a 504 at 02:48 that retried automatically in our client. End-users saw a short pause. Only ~6 sessions affected.

Jordan (CS): quick observations:
- Streaming reduces p95 by ~45% for /chat and compresses p99 (fewer extreme tails).
- /rerank non-stream has highest p99; batching limits and early-fail heuristics recommended.
- Embed cost is driving spend; propose soft budget cap alerts.

Luca (SE): suggested quick mitigation for customer: set stream=true for /chat in staging, add client-side jittered backoff on retries, and cap rerank batch tokens to 2k.

Jordan (CS): action items:
- Luca: provide a 1-page note + curl example for streaming + backoff patterns by Tue.
- Priya: collect OOM traces and add temporary pool headroom (1 GPU) by EOD.
- Jordan: send spend cap options and renewal talking points to Zoe.

InfraBot: Created ticket CH-2468-99  "SummitAI rerank tail + OOM traces" assigned to Priya.

Luca (SE): quick curl to flip streaming on for chat endpoints:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"route": "/chat", "model": "t6-small", "stream": true}'
```

Zoe (Customer): thanks  will enable streaming in staging tonight and run our p99 synthetic. Please include embed budget cap options in $ by EOD.

Jordan (CS): noted  next sync Thursday 9am PT. Thanks!
